item.title: FBI Most Wanted: Suspect captured in 2000s killing of Philadelphia 5-year-old girl
item.description: A fugitive formerly on the FBI's Most Wanted list for the kidnapping and murder of a 5-year-old girl in Philadelphia over two decades ago has been captured.The FBI announced the arrest of Alexis Flores on Friday, calling it "the culmination of 25 years of tireless investigative effort.""No matter how long it takes, the FBI will continue to pursue those who commit violent crimes and bring them to justice on behalf of victims." item.title: Inmate who escaped custody during hospital visit in Philadelphia recaptured
item.description: A Pennsylvania inmate accused of fleeing police custody during a hospital visit in Philadelphia was captured near the state's capital. Shawn Dempsey, 57, was taken to the UPenn Hospital for an appointment made by Bucks County Corrections on Jan 29th. item.title: Man shot and killed after altercation outside Philadelphia bar on 54th Street
item.description: Police say a man was shot multiple times after an altercation outside a Philadelphia bar on 54th Street just after 2 a.m. He later died at the hospital.

item.title: Man killed in West Philadelphia highway shooting; 2 others injured in separate violent incidents
item.description: One man is dead and two others were injured in three separate violent incidents across Philadelphia early Saturday, police say.

item.title: Flooding at Callowhill parking garage leaves cars in standing water in Philadelphia
item.description: Cars are sitting in standing water inside the 1601 Callowhill St. parking garage in Philadelphia as flooding continues despite crews on scene.

item.title: Pennsbury High School lockdown lifted after threat deemed 'not credible': Police
item.description: Pennsbury High School in Bucks County reopened after police determined an online threat was not credible. The campus had been placed on lockdown earlier in the morning.
